connector.name: Servicenow MCP Ai by IvanBBaev
connector.registryDescription: ServiceNow MCP server - 67 tools over the full REST surface, every auth method, flows, diagrams.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package servicenow-mcp-ai. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the ivanbbaev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: SN_AUTH
env.description: Auth mode: basic | oauth | apikey | token | none. Auto-detected from the keys present if omitted.

env.name: SN_USER
env.description: Username for basic auth or the OAuth password grant.

env.name: SN_PASSWORD
env.description: Password for basic auth or the OAuth password grant.

env.name: SN_API_KEY
env.description: ServiceNow API key, sent as the x-sn-apikey header (apikey auth).

env.name: SN_TOOL_PACKAGES
env.description: Which tool packages to expose, e.g. core (default), all, or a comma-separated list.
